// Handle /help command
const helpMessage = `📚 *Article Submission Bot Help*\n\n` +
  `Send me an article to add it to your feed. Use this format:\n\n` +
  `\`\`\`\n` +
  `URL: https://example.com/article\n` +
  `Feed: technology\n` +
  `Note: Optional description\n` +
  `\`\`\`\n\n` +
  `*Available Feeds:*\n` +
  `• default\n` +
  `• technology\n` +
  `• politics\n` +
  `• business\n` +
  `• health\n` +
  `• science\n` +
  `• brasil\n` +
  `• teclas\n\n` +
  `*Example:*\n` +
  `\`\`\`\n` +
  `URL: https://addyosmani.com/blog/self-improving-agents/\n` +
  `Feed: technology\n` +
  `\`\`\``;

msg.payload = {
  chatId: msg.chatId,
  type: "message",
  content: helpMessage
};

return msg;
